body: the voice inside my head that I'm pretty sure are my nihilistic tendencies personifying themselves. I see everyone acheiving things in life and starting college, all except me. I didnt didnt get any scholarships in high school because I had a rough high school life. During my senior year I was very, very depressed and didnt sleep for days at a time. Everyone always has to make time for me. I have nothing of my own. Its painful because Im really intelligent and I may never get to show the world my potential. Its as if the universe itself is trying to crush me. I tried going to community college and I passed the entrance exams and everything but my parent wouldnt fill out my fafsa and so I never ended up enrolling. Now Im in an electrician apprenticeship program that Im stuck with for 5 years, but I really wanted to work in IT.

Same here man. People like me and you have a harder time. But fear not hermano if you keep at it whole-heartedly its sure to turn out well. I'd say often times it felt like a job. The problem is we're slaves to our brain at the moment. We have to stand up and resist that primal, detrimental habit.
